lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible; the primary constellation posterior to the gill slits consists of large, roughly equidistant maxima (approx. 10-15 pixels diameter) arranged in approximately four longitudinal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a localized rectangular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible; the uppermost ridge shows a high-contrast vertical gradient with specular highlights on the dorsal edge and a defined shadow-line on the ventral edge, running parallel to the body axis.

other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin exhibits a high density of smaller, irregular high-luminance spots along its leading edge; multiple commensal fish are visible in close proximity to the fifth gill slit and ventral flank.
